# A tip pool has two federal rules, not one.

> Check a mandatory tip pool against federal FLSA rules: managers and supervisors are never eligible, and back-of-house staff are eligible only if you take no tip credit. See the tip-credit back-wage exposure a non-compliant pool creates. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
